author: Polar_Express
body:
This is a small map I built for walls. Please give it a look. It focuses more on good game-play than the over-all look. It is slightly bigger than normal walls map and has a unique center design that blends in to all 4 quads once the walls drop. The pics really do not show off the map that well, please download it and give it a try. Thanks - Please let me know if the yml works. I would like to submit this for Saturday's testing if we have room.

Thanks for looking.

Images: Non res:http://imgur.com/a/YovQV
Images: Res: http://imgur.com/a/pMXGP

Map and yml zip: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/4em84ubse5vorql/AACZ6tMwTJYuK2DtJWUowrcEa
